summary: Today's news is dominated by an ongoing, well-known trend of surging Treasury yields (10yr near 5%, 19-year highs) and hawkish Fed commentary ahead of midterms, plus a long-running Iran/Hormuz oil standoff that is currently pushing crude lower on diplomacy hopes rather than higher on escalation. Nothing here is a sudden, unpriced, fund-specific shock, so no risk-level change or vetoes are warranted.
